question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding the festival of Holi?

A. The night before Holi, Holika Dahan takes place and people circle around the fire, which symbolises the end of Holika.

B. The festival marks the beginning of autumn.

C. Holi festival is celebrated in Magha month(Hindu calendar).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only A**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 
**A. The night before Holi, Holika Dahan takes place and people circle around the fire, which symbolises the end of Holika.**

 
 
• This statement is accurate.
 
• Holika Dahan is a significant ritual associated with Holi.
 
• It involves the burning of a large bonfire, symbolizing the victory of good over evil.
 
• The story behind Holika Dahan is that Holika, the sister of the demon king Hiranyakashipu, tried to burn Prahlad, a devotee of Lord Vishnu.
 
• Holika was immune to fire, but Prahlad was protected by Lord Vishnu, and Holika was burned instead.
 
• People circle the fire as a form of worship and to celebrate the triumph of good.
 
• This is a very important part of the celebration.
 
• It is a symbolic burning of evil.
 
• The ritual is done the night before the colors are played.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
** The festival marks the beginning of autumn.**

 
 
• **​**Holi marks the beginning of spring, not autumn.
 
• It is celebrated at the end of winter and the beginning of the spring season.
 
• It is a festival that celebrates the arrival of spring.
 
• Spring is a time of renewal and rebirth.
 
• Autumn is the season after summer, and before winter.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Holi festival is celebrated in Magha month(Hindu calendar).**

 
 
• **​**Holi is celebrated in the Hindu month of Phalguna.
 
• It typically falls in late February or early March in the Gregorian calendar.
 
• Magha is a month before Phalguna in the Hindu calendar.
 
• The full moon day in Phalguna is the day of Holi.
 
• The Hindu calendar is a lunar calendar.
 
• Phalguna is the last month of the Hindu calender.
 
• Holi is a very popular festival in India.
 
• The festival is celebrated with great enthusiasm.
 
• The festival is a time for people to come together and celebrate.
 
• Colors are thrown on each other during the festival.
 
• Sweets are prepared and shared during the festival.
 
• The festival is a time for forgiveness and reconciliation.
 
• The festival is a time for joy and happiness.
 
• The festival is a time for family and friends.
 
• The festival is a time for celebration.
 
• The festival is a time for cultural expression.
